name: Skeptic
reason: History says every past September had a bloom, but cooler highs of 22.8, a falling satellite index, and almost no runoff give me plenty of room to doubt it this week.
evidence: max_temp_avg 22.8 with only 1 hot day, which is mild for bloom growth
cyano_index 0.183, down 0.097 vs last week, so the trend is toward decline
rain_last_14d_mm 6.7 and 0 heavy rain days, so little nutrient runoff to fuel growth
bloom_rate_this_month_past_years 1.0, the one strong argument for a bloom, but it is a base rate and not this week's reading
